Here is what turns up **on disk in this workspace** with a recursive search under `AXEL/axel_project` and `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot`.

## 1) Files containing references (explicit `combat_test_v2` / those paths)

| Path |
|------|
| `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/core/AI_CHANGELOG.md` |

Git status shows both `AXEL/axel_project/...` and `AXEL\axel_project\...`; on Windows those are usually the **same file**, not two copies.

**Not counted as separate “references” but relevant to deletion:**

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test_v2.tscn` | Scene being deleted; contains `uid://beip5b2fdev8u` only (no `[ext_resource type="Script"` to `combat_test_v2.gd`—root `CombatTest` has no attached script in this file’s text). |
| `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test_v2.gd` | Script being deleted; header says “Combat test UI **v2**” but the **identifier string** `combat_test_v2` does **not** appear in the script body from search. |

**Paths your git snapshot listed but this session’s tooling did not enumerate under `.godot`:** untracked editor metadata such as `.godot/editor/combat_test_v2.tscn-editstate-*` and `combat_test_v2.tscn-folding-*`. If those files exist on your machine, they are **suffix-hash** filenames; `glob **/*combat_test_v2*` under `.godot` would collect them.

**Checked and no substring `combat_test_v2`:** `project.godot`, `.vscode/*`, combat `README.md` / `README_COMBAT_TEST_VERSIONS.md`, `logs/`, `.cursor/` (under this workspace), and current `editor_layout.cfg` (`open_scenes` / `open_scripts` lists no v2 paths).

Cross-check: **`combat/scripts/combat_test.gd`** extends **`combat_test_v1.gd`**; **`combat/combat_test.tscn`** references **`res://combat/scripts/combat_test.gd`**—no v2 linkage there.

---

## 2) Runtime-critical vs docs / editor cache

| Category | Location | Notes |
|----------|----------|--------|
| **Runtime-critical (none found)** | — | No other `.gd` / `.tscn` under `AXEL/axel_project` contains `combat_test_v2`. Main playtest paths use `combat_test.tscn` + `combat_test.gd` → v1 implementation. |
| **Documentation only** | `plans/core/AI_CHANGELOG.md` | Historical changelog text listing `combat_test_v2.tscn` / `combat_test_v2.gd` and rollout/removal narrative. Removing v2 assets does **not** require deleting this unless you **choose** to edit history for cleanliness. |
| **Editor / local cache** | `.godot/editor/*combat_test_v2*`, `scripts/combat_test_v2.gd.uid`, any `scene_groups_cache.cfg` / `filesystem_cache*` after delete | Harmless orphans if left behind; safest hygiene is deletion or regeneration of editor cache entries. **`uid_cache.bin`** is binary; Godot reconciles after reopen—manual binary edit is unnecessary. |
| **“Self” reference** | The v2 `.gd` / `.tscn` / `.uid` you are deleting | Not a cross-reference; delete with the bundle. |

**Related but not literal `combat_test_v2` references:** `combat_test_v2.gd` preloads `chip_bar_segment.gd` and `matched_log_tile.gd`. After removing v2, confirm nothing else imports those scripts; otherwise treat as follow-up orphans.

---

## 3) Recommended safe deletion / cleanup sequence

1. **Optional:** Close Godot so it does not rewrite caches while files disappear.
2. **Final grep** (outside Ask mode): `combat_test_v2` plus `extends` / `preload` / scene `Script` paths, to satisfy “nothing left loads v2”.
3. **Delete versioned assets (and `.uid`):**  
   `combat_test_v2.tscn`, `combat/scripts/combat_test_v2.gd`, **`combat/scripts/combat_test_v2.gd.uid`** if present (keeps UID map consistent).
4. **Strip editor noise:** Delete `.godot/editor/*combat_test_v2*` (folding/editstate/session fragments). Omitting this only leaves stale bookmarks in cache; reopening sometimes leaves harmless dead entries until Godot cleans up.
5. **Re-open project:** Let Godot refresh `filesystem_cache`, `scene_groups_cache`, and `global_script_class_cache` as needed rather than editing binary caches by hand unless you maintain them in-repo.
6. **Docs governance:** Decide whether `AI_CHANGELOG.md` stays as historical audit trail (typical) or gets a tiny follow-up sentence that v2 files were physically removed later—purely editorial, **not runtime**.

If you want a second-pass search that **includes commented-out references** without the substring (e.g. `res://combat/combat_test_v2.tscn` split oddly), switching to Agent mode can run broader patterns; Ask mode tooling here already covered normal `*.gd`, `*.tscn`, `*.md`, `project.godot`, and readable `.godot` text files.
